evidence: Running `bash run_repro.sh` in the local venv exits with `TypeError: cannot unpack non-iterable NoneType object` at `codebase/torch_geometric/distributed/rpc.py:123` inside `rpc_partition_to_workers`.
steps: Created a local CPU-only virtualenv and installed `torch==2.5.1+cpu` plus `numpy==2.2.1`.
Bootstrapped `torch.distributed.rpc` with a single local worker so the RPC decorator gate is satisfied.
Patched `global_all_gather` to return a worker map containing one `None` value.
Called `rpc_partition_to_workers(...)` and observed the same unpacking TypeError from the issue report.
